nodes.label: Fault F65.2 — the s65 diagnostic presented a delivered result as new
Standing 6 — search the archive by content before declaring a gap
nodes.rationale: The rule exists so a session does not spend its highest-priority slot re-deriving a closed item. Run after the write-up it fires too late (F65.2); run at ruling time it kills the item before any prediction is filed (F66.1); run as a bridge itself requires it catches a false trend before any solve (F67.1).

nodes.label: The collapse condition κ, with the transit / plateau distinction
nodes.rationale: Deliverable 3 already held κ = D/(-1/2n²) with n* and delta, nothing fitted; that collapse is SHARP not gradual; the tie-break clause with its domain; and that Ac(89) is the PLATEAU case while La(57) and Th(90) are TRANSIT cases — a distinction the s65 diagnostic collapsed into one phenomenon, which is the exact error PK-1/PK-2 were falsified for.
